articles.title: Databricks acquires Row Zero for governed spreadsheets
articles.summary: Databricks acquired Row Zero to bring a native spreadsheet interface to Genie, letting business teams analyze live enterprise data with built-in permissions and auditability. The planned integration supports familiar formulas and pivot tables while reducing reliance on exported files that lose governance controls.

articles.title: AWS becomes first hyperscaler to secure ‘NATO Restricted' approval
articles.summary: Amazon Web Services has become the first hyperscaler to receive NATO Restricted approval, allowing member nations and defense partners to handle mission-critical restricted workloads across 15 qualifying AWS Regions. Evaluated by Spain's National Cryptographic Centre, the accreditation provides a pre-assisted security baseline and streamlined access to cloud capabilities for the alliance.

articles.title: Anthropic signs $11.6 billion cloud deal with Akamai
articles.summary: Anthropic committed $11.6 billion over seven years to Akamai's cloud infrastructure to support growing CPU workloads. The agreement could expand by another $9 billion and includes warrants that could give Anthropic roughly a 5% stake in Akamai.

articles.title: The Humanoid Lesson, or, Will AI Leave Anything for Database Researchers to Do?
articles.summary: Foundation models face the same tribal knowledge challenges as human workers rather than requiring specialized database architectures. Advances in general foundation models will continue to subsume custom agent harnesses, making standard software documentation practices the primary solution for semantic context.

articles.title: Devin now works across Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365
articles.summary: Cognition has launched native support for @ mentioning Devin in Microsoft Teams alongside a first-party Microsoft 365 integration. The update allows Devin to participate directly in Teams chats, channels, and threads, as well as connect to mail, calendar, files, tasks, and directory services through Microsoft 365 MCP servers. The integrations feature delegated per-user permissions and resource-specific consent controls designed for security review.

articles.title: UiPath maps the missing layer for enterprise AI with Cartographer
articles.summary: UiPath announced Cartographer and the Map of Work at its FUSION 2026 event, introducing a new product designed to capture enterprise processes and generate governed process maps for AI agents and automations. The tool uses AI to absorb existing documentation, interview experts, and track decisions through a ledger to keep process maps continuously updated.

articles.title: Docker launches cloud sandboxes for long-running agents
articles.summary: Docker introduced managed cloud sandboxes that let coding agents keep working after developers disconnect, with a command to move sandbox files between local and cloud environments. Each agent runs in its own microVM, with configurable network access and usage-based compute pricing starting at $0.07 per hour.

articles.title: Ubuntu moves to weekly kernel releases as CVEs pile up
articles.summary: Canonical is replacing Ubuntu's existing kernel update cadence with overlapping two-week cycles that produce a release every week. The change aims to shorten patch delays as AI-assisted bug discovery and broader Linux CVE reporting increase the vulnerability backlog.

articles.title: Pinecone brings managed vector data to customer clouds
articles.summary: Pinecone's Bring Your Own Cloud offering is generally available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, keeping customer data and queries inside customer-controlled accounts. Pinecone manages upgrades and scaling through an outbound, pull-based mechanism without requiring standing inbound access to the environment.

articles.title: Ando takes on Slack
articles.summary: Ando is building team messaging designed for employees and AI agents to collaborate.

articles.title: Kubernetes patches Windows kubelet NTLM coercion via subPath
articles.summary: Kubernetes has fixed a medium-severity vulnerability designated CVE-2026-76654 in the Windows kubelet that could force NTLM authentication to an attacker-controlled network share.
